sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD 81/HA, Wickes, Hertford Road.
The current record gives 880 minimum and 899 maximum net dwellings on 1.3ha.
The register marks the site deliverable; deliverable is not the same as permissioned.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority, which does not identify a named owner or title.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an exact application or title polygon.
The 8 September 2025 Planning Committee considered the Wickes Development at Hertford Road.
The Committee report presentation described 880 residential flats in six buildings.
The buildings were described as ranging from 18 to 31 storeys.
The proposal also included flexible commercial and community floorspace plus public-realm and riverside-path works.
No exact issued decision notice or completed legal-agreement readback was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.
Adopted Local Plan context guides decisions but does not convert a pending application into permission.

examples.result: HA retains 880-899 capacity and pending-decision status.
The 880-flat Committee proposal aligns with the register minimum but does not prove final issue.
899 maximum is not treated as an approved uplift above 880.
Committee consideration is not silently converted into an issued decision notice.
Commercial/community floorspace does not change dwelling counts.
Point and ownership category are not HMLR evidence.
Promotion remains zero until exact final decision, title relation and overlays are verified.
